generations.prompt: Ashling, a small thin ash imp monster for a JRPG side-view battle, standing upright, facing right. Slim ash-grey and charred-brown body like burnt wood, small branching antler-like horns on its head, glowing orange ember eyes, a glowing ember crack running down its chest, thin arms and legs, dark charcoal feet. Idle stance. Large sprite that fills the canvas height. Clean readable pixel art sprite with dark outline, single character centred, feet at the bottom, transparent background.
idle breathing loop: thin body sways slightly, ember crack on its chest pulses, feet stay planted in place
claw attack: pulls its arm back to wind up, then lunges forward to the right and slashes with its claws, then steps back to its stance
ash spit spell: leans back and inhales, the ember crack glows brighter, then it spits a glob of glowing ash forward to the right, then straightens
taking a hit: recoils backwards to the left, hunches over, eyes squeeze shut, antlers tilt back, then recovers
death: staggers, knees buckle, it collapses forward onto the ground and crumbles into a small pile of grey ash with fading embers
